reason: Provides a local vision tool that reads specified images and uses configured OpenAI-compatible local inference servers to generate descriptions or answer image questions.

summaries.zh: 通过配置的本地 OpenAI 兼容推理服务分析指定图片，并生成图像描述或回答相关问题。
summaries.en: Analyzes specified images through configured local OpenAI-compatible inference servers and generates descriptions or answers image-related questions.

capabilities: Sends image data to configured local OpenAI-compatible inference endpoints
Probes endpoints and selects an available vision model
Returns image descriptions or answers to image questions
